# People and segments

People are the authors behind the mentions: one row per person with every account of theirs (`accounts`), reach (`reach.followers`), the public profile when the platform has one (`profile`: bio, company, location, website, email, linked accounts), per-workspace `stats` (mentions, negatives, intents seen, first and last seen) and the workspace's own `annotations` (tags, notes, muted). Ids are `aut_...`; an account merged into someone resolves to that person.

Sorting answers most questions: `reach` for influencers, `new` for new voices, `mentions` for the loudest, `recent` for the latest. Filters stack: `minFollowers`, `intents`, `keywordKinds` (people who mentioned a competitor), `neverKeywordKinds` (and never the brand), `newSinceDays`, `tags`. The list is offset-paginated (`{ data, total }`, `limit` and `offset`).

A segment is a saved people filter with a name, evaluated live on every read (`GET /v1/segments` returns each with its current size and a few presets to save as a starting point); pass `segmentId` to `GET /v1/people` to list its members. Annotations are per workspace: tags and notes for the user's own organization, `muted` hides the person's posts from the feed and every channel without touching ingest or billing. A merge declares two accounts one human; a split undoes it. Confirm before merging or deleting a segment.

Base URL `https://api.mentio.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. The `mentio` CLI command for each endpoint is listed for when it is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Examples

```bash
# The ten people with the most reach who mentioned us, then new voices this month
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/people?sort=reach&limit=10" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/people?sort=new&newSinceDays=30&limit=20" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"

# Switch prospects: mentioned a competitor, never the brand, with an audience
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/people?keywordKinds=competitor&neverKeywordKinds=brand&minFollowers=1000&sort=reach" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"

# Tag and annotate one; mute another
curl -sS -X PATCH "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/people/aut_1c2d..." -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tags": ["customer", "vip"], "notes": "Talked at KubeCon"}'
curl -sS -X PATCH "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/people/aut_9e8f..." -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"muted": true}'

# Save the prospects filter as a segment and list its members
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/segments" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "Switch prospects", "filter": {"keywordKinds": ["competitor"], "neverKeywordKinds": ["brand"], "minFollowers": 1000}}'
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/people?segmentId=seg_...&sort=reach" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | CLI | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/people` | `mentio people:list` | List people |
| `GET` | `/v1/people/{id}` | `mentio people:get` | Get a person |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/people/{id}` | `mentio people:update` | Update your annotations on a person |
| `POST` | `/v1/people/{id}/merge` | `mentio people:merge` | Merge an account into a person |
| `POST` | `/v1/people/{id}/split` | `mentio people:split` | Undo a merge |
| `GET` | `/v1/people/export.csv` | `mentio people:export` | Export people as CSV |
| `GET` | `/v1/segments` | `mentio segments:list` | List segments |
| `POST` | `/v1/segments` | `mentio segments:create` | Create a segment |
| `GET` | `/v1/segments/{id}` | `mentio segments:get` | Get a segment |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/segments/{id}` | `mentio segments:update` | Update a segment |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/segments/{id}` | `mentio segments:delete` | Delete a segment |

### GET /v1/people

**List people.** The people behind your mentions: one row per person, with their accounts, reach, public profile, per-workspace stats and your annotations. Filter by platform, tag, follower range, mention counts, intents seen, keyword kinds mentioned or never mentioned, or a saved segment. Offset-paginated with a total.

CLI: `mentio people:list`

Query:

- `platform` (string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. People with an account on this platform.
- `q` (string): Matches the display name or the profile handle or URL, case-insensitively.
- `tag` (string): Only people carrying this tag (exact, case-sensitive).
- `muted` (boolean): true: only muted people; false: only unmuted; omitted: everyone.
- `since` (string): Only people whose first matched mention is at or after this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).
- `segmentId` (string): A saved segment applied on top of every other filter here. Unknown id: 404.
- `platforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. People with an account on any of these platforms. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
- `tags` (array of string, nullable): People carrying any of these tags. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
- `minFollowers` (integer, nullable): At least this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.
- `maxFollowers` (integer, nullable): At most this many followers.
- `minMentions` (integer): At least this many matched mentions.
- `minNegative` (integer): At least this many negative mentions.
- `intents` (array of string, nullable): At least one mention carrying any of these intents.
- `keywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Mentioned a keyword of any of these kinds.
- `neverKeywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Never mentioned a keyword of these kinds.
- `newSinceDays` (integer): First seen within this many days.
- `sort` (string): one of `mentions`, `recent`, `reach`, `new`. mentions: most matches first. recent: last seen first. reach: most followers first, unknown last. new: first seen most recently first.
- `limit` (integer): Page size, 1 to 100.
- `offset` (integer, nullable): Skip this many people. Offset paging: a grouped read over hundreds of people, not a stream.

Returns: 200, `{ data: Person[], total }` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/people/{id}

**Get a person.** One person as your workspace sees them. An account merged into someone resolves to that person.

CLI: `mentio people:get`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Person id (aut_...).

Returns: 200, a `Person` (see Shapes below).

### PATCH /v1/people/{id}

**Update your annotations on a person.** Tags, notes and mute, for your workspace only. Mute hides their posts from your feed and every channel; ingest and billing never change.

CLI: `mentio people:update`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Person id (aut_...).

Body (JSON): Omitted fields are untouched.

- `tags` (array of string): Replaces the whole list.
- `notes` (string)
- `muted` (boolean)

Returns: 200, a `Person` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/people/{id}/merge

**Merge an account into a person.** Declare that this account and another person are the same human, for your workspace only. Their mentions, tags and notes combine under the person named by `into`.

CLI: `mentio people:merge`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Person id (aut_...).

Body (JSON):

- `into` (string, required): The person to fold this account into (their id).

Returns: 200, a `Person` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/people/{id}/split

**Undo a merge.** The account becomes its own person again.

CLI: `mentio people:split`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Person id (aut_...).

Returns: 200, a `Person` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/people/export.csv

**Export people as CSV.** The same list as GET /v1/people (segmentId included) as CSV, one row per person with their contact columns: handle, followers, email, website, company, location, tags. Capped at 5,000 people. At most 6 exports per minute per workspace; a 429 carries Retry-After.

CLI: `mentio people:export`

Query:

- `platform` (string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. People with an account on this platform.
- `q` (string): Matches the display name or the profile handle or URL, case-insensitively.
- `tag` (string): Only people carrying this tag (exact, case-sensitive).
- `muted` (boolean): true: only muted people; false: only unmuted; omitted: everyone.
- `since` (string): Only people whose first matched mention is at or after this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms).
- `segmentId` (string): A saved segment applied on top of every other filter here. Unknown id: 404.
- `platforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. People with an account on any of these platforms. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
- `tags` (array of string, nullable): People carrying any of these tags. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
- `minFollowers` (integer, nullable): At least this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.
- `maxFollowers` (integer, nullable): At most this many followers.
- `minMentions` (integer): At least this many matched mentions.
- `minNegative` (integer): At least this many negative mentions.
- `intents` (array of string, nullable): At least one mention carrying any of these intents.
- `keywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Mentioned a keyword of any of these kinds.
- `neverKeywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Never mentioned a keyword of these kinds.
- `newSinceDays` (integer): First seen within this many days.
- `sort` (string): one of `mentions`, `recent`, `reach`, `new`. mentions: most matches first. recent: last seen first. reach: most followers first, unknown last. new: first seen most recently first.

Returns: 200, CSV text.

### GET /v1/segments

**List segments.** Your saved segments, each with the number of people in it right now (segments are evaluated on every read, never materialized), plus presets you can save as a starting point. Pass a segment id to GET /v1/people to list its members.

CLI: `mentio segments:list`

Returns: 200, `{ data: Segment[], presets }` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/segments

**Create a segment.**

CLI: `mentio segments:create`

Body (JSON):

- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string)
- `filter` (object)
  - `platforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. People with an account on any of these platforms.
  - `tags` (array of string): People carrying any of these tags.
  - `minFollowers` (integer): At least this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.
  - `maxFollowers` (integer): At most this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.
  - `minMentions` (integer): At least this many matched mentions.
  - `minNegative` (integer): At least this many negative mentions.
  - `intents` (array of string): At least one mention carrying any of these intents.
  - `keywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Mentioned a keyword of any of these kinds.
  - `neverKeywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Never mentioned a keyword of these kinds.
  - `newSinceDays` (integer): First seen within this many days.
  - `muted` (boolean): true: only muted people; false: only unmuted.

Returns: 201, a `Segment` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/segments/{id}

**Get a segment.**

CLI: `mentio segments:get`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Segment id (seg_...).

Returns: 200, a `Segment` (see Shapes below).

### DELETE /v1/segments/{id}

**Delete a segment.** Nobody in it is affected.

CLI: `mentio segments:delete`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Segment id (seg_...).

Returns: 204, no body.

## Shapes

### Person

- `id` (string, required): Person id (aut_...): the canonical account. An account merged into someone resolves to that person.
- `platform` (string, required): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. Platform of the canonical account; `accounts` lists every account.
- `name` (string, required, nullable): Display name as of their newest post; null when the platform has none.
- `handle` (string, required, nullable): Platform handle of the canonical account, formatted as the platform shows it.
- `url` (string, required, nullable): Profile URL of the canonical account.
- `avatarUrl` (string, required, nullable)
- `accounts` (array of object, required): Every account this workspace treats as this person, the canonical one first.
  - `id` (string, required): The account id (aut_...); the canonical one equals the person id.
  - `platform` (string, required): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin.
  - `name` (string, required, nullable): Display name as the platform reports it.
  - `handle` (string, required, nullable): Platform handle derived from the profile URL, formatted as the platform shows it.
  - `url` (string, required, nullable): Profile URL.
- `reach` (object, required): Platform counts as of their newest post; null where the platform has no such number.
  - `followers` (integer, required, nullable)
  - `following` (integer, required, nullable)
  - `posts` (integer, required, nullable)
- `profile` (object, required, nullable): Public profile facts; null until looked up.
  - `bio` (string, required, nullable)
  - `company` (string, required, nullable)
  - `location` (string, required, nullable)
  - `website` (string, required, nullable)
  - `email` (string, required, nullable): Only when the person made it public on the platform.
  - `links` (array of object, required): Other accounts the person lists on their profile.
    - `provider` (string, required)
    - `url` (string, required)
  - `fetchedAt` (string, required): When the profile was read.
- `stats` (object, required): Computed over this workspace's matches.
  - `mentions` (integer, required): Every match of theirs for this workspace, relevant or not.
  - `relevant` (integer, required): Of those, scored relevant.
  - `sentiment` (object, required)
    - `positive` (integer, required)
    - `neutral` (integer, required)
    - `negative` (integer, required)
  - `firstSeenAt` (string, required): Their oldest matched post.
  - `lastSeenAt` (string, required): Their newest matched post.
- `annotations` (object, required): What this workspace wrote about the person.
  - `tags` (array of string, required)
  - `notes` (string, required)
  - `muted` (boolean, required): Their posts stay out of the feed and every channel; ingest and billing are untouched.

### Segment

- `id` (string, required): Segment id (seg_...).
- `name` (string, required)
- `description` (string, required)
- `filter` (object, required)
  - `platforms` (array of string): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. People with an account on any of these platforms.
  - `tags` (array of string): People carrying any of these tags.
  - `minFollowers` (integer): At least this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.
  - `maxFollowers` (integer): At most this many followers. Unknown reach never matches.
  - `minMentions` (integer): At least this many matched mentions.
  - `minNegative` (integer): At least this many negative mentions.
  - `intents` (array of string): At least one mention carrying any of these intents.
  - `keywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Mentioned a keyword of any of these kinds.
  - `neverKeywordKinds` (array of string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. Never mentioned a keyword of these kinds.
  - `newSinceDays` (integer): First seen within this many days.
  - `muted` (boolean): true: only muted people; false: only unmuted.
- `count` (integer, required): People in the segment right now; it is evaluated on every read.
- `createdAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
- `updatedAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
